name: CCAA Cross Country Championships
where: San Bernardino, CA · host Cal State San Bernardino · CSUSB XC Course
headline: CCAA Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Chico State swept the titles: the men scored 28 to Cal Poly Pomona’s 66 and the women 29 to Stanislaus State’s 50. Cal Poly Pomona’s Ricardo Vargas won the men’s race in 24:17.8 and Chico State’s Della Molina the women’s in 20:28.7.
